rows.apparatus_type: error-mapped Moore M48 coordinate measuring machine with tactile probe and fixtured multi-step artefact
calculated_outputs_not_counted: any unit-converted copy of the same separation
rows.classical_representation: effective Euclidean coordinate separations / dimensional length chain
rows.controlled_input_or_intervention: re-probe successive step faces/locations under controlled fixturing, thermal conditions, coordinate-system generation and process-control sequence
rows.definition_stripped_operational_constrai: Across repeated physical contacts with multiple artefact faces, the pairwise separation relations remain mutually coherent under re-probing/fixturing/process-control changes within the source-stated CMM uncertainty envelope; coordinate names and length-unit scaling are not counted as evidence.
rows.material_or_realization: solid 1-D step gauges; service allows standard or non-traditional materials/designs
rows.measured_output: contact-derived coordinate observations and reported step-to-step separations
rows.measurement_chain: probe contact -> CMM coordinate acquisition/process control -> step-to-step separation report
rows.protocol: NIST M48 CMM tactile measurement of long one-dimensional step gauges
rows.scale_regime: long artefacts approaching 1 m in protocol paper; NIST service covers 1-D step gauges up to 1.5 m

rows.apparatus_type: synthesized voltage/current source, phase-angle standard, timing/synchronization chain, PMU data interface
calculated_outputs_not_counted: any algebraically computed loop-closure sum from the same phase samples
derived total-vector-error aggregates when based on the same raw reports
rows.classical_representation: effective periodic phasors and relative phase angle
rows.controlled_input_or_intervention: select nominal 50 or 60 Hz; impose phase relation; vary reporting rate, voltage/current amplitudes and phase sequence/unbalance where applicable
rows.definition_stripped_operational_constrai: Independently reported periodic channels track imposed relative timing/phase relations and remain mutually consistent as nominal frequency/reporting conditions are varied, within the source-calibrated phase-setting envelope; angular unit and cycle-origin conventions are quotiented out.
rows.material_or_realization: electronic power-system instrumentation and three-phase voltage/current channels
rows.measured_output: time-stamped PMU voltage/current reports and direct phase-error observations relative to the traceable source
rows.measurement_chain: imposed voltage/current waveform and timing -> PMU sampling/timestamping -> reported phasor/phase data compared with source standard
rows.protocol: NIST PMU/synchrophasor calibration using traceable low-frequency phase-angle generation
rows.scale_regime: 50/60 Hz power-system signals; PMU service up to 120 V rms and 5 A rms

rows.apparatus_type: modulated CW pump laser, co-axial probe laser, Au transducer/sample stack, balanced photodetection and lock-in amplifier
calculated_outputs_not_counted: thermal conductivity fitted from the phase curve
volumetric heat capacity fitted from the phase curve
thermal interface conductance/resistance fitted from the phase curve
rows.classical_representation: effective multilayer diffusive thermal response / frequency-domain heat-transport transfer function
rows.controlled_input_or_intervention: sweep pump modulation frequency from 100 Hz to 20 MHz in 40 logarithmic intervals while holding optical geometry/sample configuration under protocol controls
rows.definition_stripped_operational_constrai: After quotienting angular-unit and reference-path conventions, localized periodic heating produces a stable, material-dependent delayed-response curve across a wide modulation-frequency sweep; the measured response curve, not fitted thermal parameters, is the holdout evidence.
definition_unit_normalization_dependenci: angular phase unit and reference-phase subtraction convention
Au transducer thickness and thermal-property inputs
multilayer diffusive model used only for derived parameter fitting
rows.material_or_realization: Au-transducer-coated Borofloat silica, quartz, sapphire and silicon reference substrates / thin-film stacks
rows.measured_output: reference-corrected reflected-probe phase-lag samples as a function of modulation frequency
rows.measurement_chain: pump modulation -> local optical heating -> reflected probe modulation -> lock-in phase measurement -> reference-phase correction
rows.protocol: NIST frequency-domain thermoreflectance (FDTR) modulated optical pump-probe measurement
rows.scale_regime: thermal-property measurement length scales approximately 10 nm to approximately 10 micrometres; actual measurement sweep 100 Hz to 20 MHz

uncertainty_tolerance_error_envelope.meaning: LIA sweeper output standard deviation; includes LIA phase noise density, laser electronics, balanced photodetector electronics and thermoreflectance measurement contribution

rows.apparatus_type: nominal 450 mm x 60 mm cylindrical cavity, motorized tuning endplate, coupling loops, coaxial lines and automatic network analyzer
calculated_outputs_not_counted: fitted resonant frequency f0 as an independent measurement channel
fitted quality factor Q as an independent measurement channel
rows.classical_representation: effective bounded resonator eigenmode / resonance-curve description
rows.controlled_input_or_intervention: frequency sweep; insert/remove dielectric sample; change cavity length with motorized endplate and retune around the selected resonance
rows.definition_stripped_operational_constrai: A bounded physical resonator under frequency sweep exhibits reproducible isolated response peaks whose locations/widths change coherently under controlled sample insertion and boundary retuning; raw response-curve structure is evidence, while mode names and fitted dielectric parameters are not.
rows.material_or_realization: empty cavity and cross-linked-polystyrene sample-loaded cavity; gold-plated endplates/helical cavity wall
rows.measured_output: frequency-indexed complex scattering-parameter observations / squared-magnitude resonance curve
rows.measurement_chain: frequency sweep -> coupled cavity response -> complex scattering parameter samples -> resonance-curve observations; optional WLS estimation kept downstream
rows.protocol: NIST 60 mm cylindrical microwave cavity resonance measurement with automatic network analyzer
rows.scale_regime: microwave cavity around 10 GHz; supporting material characterization spans approximately 8 to 11 GHz

uncertainty_tolerance_error_envelope.eligibility_rule: row is eligible only when the source-defined curve-noise/WLS uncertainty is retained; no unsourced global frequency tolerance is introduced
uncertainty_tolerance_error_envelope.raw_environmental_control: water-bath cavity temperature controlled within ±0.1 degree C
uncertainty_tolerance_error_envelope.resonance_estimator_rule: weighted nonlinear least squares with frequency-dependent additive-noise variance; source computes one-sigma uncertainty/covariance for fitted resonant frequency and Q from each observed curve
uncertainty_tolerance_error_envelope.systematic_correction_context_not_tolera: skin-depth resonant-frequency correction under 100 kHz or 0.001% in the approximately 10 GHz, Q≈70000 TE0123 case

rows.apparatus_type: water flow loop, controlled flow, collection tank on weighing system, meter under test
calculated_outputs_not_counted: volume flow converted from mass flow
rows.classical_representation: effective mass/inventory balance over a control volume and time interval
rows.controlled_input_or_intervention: set/stabilize water-flow setpoint and collect continuously over time
rows.definition_stripped_operational_constrai: The independently sampled increase of receiving-system inventory tracks through-boundary transfer over the same controlled interval within the source uncertainty, after quotienting unit choice and calibration scale.
rows.measured_output: time-dependent buoyancy-corrected accumulated water mass and meter-under-test output
rows.measurement_chain: controlled water transfer -> buoyancy-corrected accumulating tank mass sampled in time -> rate-of-mass-accumulation comparison with through-flow meter
rows.protocol: NIST 15 kg/s fully dynamic gravimetric liquid-flow standard

rows.apparatus_type: diverter valve system, thermostatted known-volume collection tanks, pressure/temperature/time instrumentation
calculated_outputs_not_counted: gas density calculated from the state equation
flow value recomputed in another volume/mass unit
rows.classical_representation: effective gas inventory/flow balance using pressure-volume-temperature-time state realization
rows.controlled_input_or_intervention: divert steady gas flow into a selected collection tank for a measured time interval across the supported flow range
rows.definition_stripped_operational_constrai: For a controlled transfer interval, independently observed receiving-system state change determines an inventory increment consistent with the through-boundary transfer, within the source uncertainty; the residual survives removal of standard-volume convention.
rows.material_or_realization: gas collected in 34 L / 677 L PVTt tanks
rows.measured_output: collection interval plus tank pressure/temperature state observations used to determine inventory change
rows.measurement_chain: steady gas flow -> rapid diversion to collection tank for measured interval -> P/V/T inventory determination -> flow comparison
rows.scale_regime: 1 standard litre/min to 2000 standard litre/min in the 2003 primary-standard description

rows.apparatus_type: three laboratory standard microphones, long/short air-filled plane-wave couplers, reciprocity calibration apparatus, synthesizer, filters and voltmeter
calculated_outputs_not_counted: final solved microphone sensitivities as separate evidence channels
rows.classical_representation: effective reciprocal electroacoustic transfer relation and microphone pressure sensitivity
rows.controlled_input_or_intervention: permute transmitter/receiver pairings within the three-microphone triad and sweep test frequency
rows.definition_stripped_operational_constrai: After removing logarithmic/unit normalization and coupler corrections, directed transfer measurements remain compatible under transmitter/receiver role interchange and triad permutation within the source uncertainty envelope.
rows.material_or_realization: electroacoustic microphones coupled through controlled air-filled cavities
rows.measured_output: receiver-to-capacitor voltage ratios for each transmitter/receiver pair, with pressure/temperature/humidity observations
rows.measurement_chain: electrically drive one microphone as transmitter -> coupled acoustic field -> paired microphone receiver voltage; repeat over all three transmitter/receiver pairings
rows.protocol: NIST primary pressure-reciprocity calibration of a three-microphone triad
rows.scale_regime: 31.5 Hz to 2000 Hz frozen subrange where both long and short couplers are used

rows.apparatus_type: three antennas, RF source/receiver instrumentation and controlled separation range
calculated_outputs_not_counted: solved absolute antenna gains as separate measured channels
rows.classical_representation: effective reciprocal antenna transfer / gain extrapolation
rows.controlled_input_or_intervention: permute the three antenna pairings and vary separation distance
rows.definition_stripped_operational_constrai: After factoring gain-unit and separation-model conventions, pairwise directed transfer data across three physical antennas remain mutually compatible under source/receiver role exchange and pairing permutation within the source uncertainty.
definition_unit_normalization_dependenci: antenna orientation and polarization coordinate description
rows.measured_output: received signal for each antenna pair as a function of separation
rows.measurement_chain: transmit between an antenna pair -> measure received signal as separation is varied -> repeat for three pairwise combinations
rows.scale_regime: 2 GHz to 30 GHz frozen service subrange
